advancedArguments.name: keyword
advancedArguments.description: A word or phrase to narrow the results by (e.g. 'MS Excel', 'DevOps', 'backend dev'). Matched word-by-word, PARTIAL match per word (e.g. 'dev' matches 'Development', 'backend' matches 'Backend') against both the existing need category names and individual need records. Optional - omit to list everything visible to this Supervisor.
